lead.zh-Hans: 那声喷嚏，把我和鸭子都打断了。
lead.en: A sneeze interrupted both me and the duck.

text.zh-Hans: 国家花园的鸭池边，我蹲下看一只鸭子整理羽毛，鼻子却忽然痒起来。刚想忍住，喷嚏已经打了出来，鸭子抬头看我，旁边的小朋友也抬头看我。我赶紧轻声道歉，孩子说等它忙完再打招呼。我点点头，退到不挡路的地方，鼻尖还留着刚才揉出来的一点红。
text.en: By the National Garden's duck pond, I crouched to watch a duck tidy its feathers. My nose began to tickle. Before I could stop it, I sneezed. Both the duck and a nearby child looked up. I apologised quietly. The child suggested waiting until the duck was finished before saying hello. I nodded and moved clear of the path, still rubbing a slightly pink nose.

text.zh-Hans: 等鸭子理好羽毛再问候
text.en: Wait until the duck finishes before saying hello

text.zh-Hans: 看看鸭子怎样收拢羽毛
text.en: Watch the duck settle its feathers

lead.zh-Hans: 小车停住了，轮子前只有一颗石子。
lead.en: One little stone had stopped the wagon.

text.zh-Hans: 在尼亚尔霍斯公园的橄榄树旁，一个孩子拉着玩具小车经过，轮子忽然卡住了。我帮他扶着车身，他用手指拨开轮前的小石子，车子立刻往前一动，我却还握着后边。他回头提醒我松手，我才赶紧放开。小车又跑起来，里面那只绒布熊始终坐得比我稳。
text.en: Near the olive trees in Stavros Niarchos Park, a child's toy wagon came to a stop. I steadied its side while the child moved a small stone from in front of a wheel. The wagon shifted forward, but I was still holding the back. A glance over their shoulder reminded me to let go. Off it went, with its stuffed bear seated much more steadily than I had managed.

text.zh-Hans: 问问小车里的熊坐稳没有
text.en: Ask whether the bear has a steady seat

text.zh-Hans: 看看轮子前还有没有石子
text.en: Check the way ahead of the wheel

lead.zh-Hans: 我放下叉子，午饭却还牵着它。
lead.en: I put down the fork, but lunch had not let go.

text.zh-Hans: 切开菠菜派，我用叉子卷起一口，放下时却带出一条长长的菜叶。它一头留在馅里，一头绕着叉齿，我转一下，它也跟着转一下。邻座递来小刀，我先把盘子稳稳扶住，轻轻把菜叶分开。叉子终于能放平，那一小段绿色的馅还留在盘沿，等我把别的部分吃完。
text.en: I cut into my spanakopita and wound up a forkful, but a long piece of greens remained attached. One end stayed in the filling while the other followed each turn of my fork. My neighbour offered a knife. I steadied the plate and gently separated them. The fork could lie flat at last, leaving a small green piece by the rim for a later bite.

text.zh-Hans: 谢谢借来分开菜叶的小刀
text.en: Thank my neighbour for the knife

text.zh-Hans: 看看叉齿上还缠着什么
text.en: Check what remains around the fork

lead.zh-Hans: 杯子放下了，拇指却还粘在杯柄上。
lead.en: The cup went down while my thumb stayed attached.

text.zh-Hans: 蜂蜜炸面团球吃到一半，我伸手去拿水杯，才发现拇指上沾了蜂蜜。喝完水把杯子放下，手指却还粘在杯柄上，杯子又被带起一点。我只好重新坐稳，用另一只手扶住杯底，慢慢松开。店员看见，给我送来温湿的布巾，拇指擦干净以后，终于能独自抬起来了。
text.en: Halfway through my honey-covered loukoumades, I reached for water without noticing the honey on my thumb. When I set down the cup, my thumb stayed on the handle and lifted it again. I settled back, steadied the base with my other hand, and slowly peeled away. A server brought a warm damp cloth. Once wiped clean, my thumb could rise without bringing the cup along.

text.zh-Hans: 谢谢送来湿布巾的店员
text.en: Thank the server for the damp cloth

text.zh-Hans: 看看杯柄上有没有蜂蜜
text.en: Check the handle for honey

lead.zh-Hans: 我说可以搭话，围巾却先替我点了头。
lead.en: I tried to answer while my scarf nodded for me.

text.zh-Hans: 围巾刚绕到脖子上，一位旅人便问旁边能不能坐。我在国家花园歇脚，吃过菠菜派和蜂蜜炸球的肚子还鼓鼓的，手上却忙着理结。我低头答应，声音全闷在围巾里，他以为没听见，又问一遍。我赶紧拉低围巾，露出嘴巴请他坐下，松开的那一头刚好搭到了自己的膝盖。
text.en: A visitor asked about the empty seat just as I wrapped my scarf around my neck. I was resting in the National Garden after spanakopita and loukoumades, with my hands busy fixing the knot. I looked down to answer and muffled every word. They asked again. I lowered the scarf and invited them to sit, leaving its loosened end across my knees.

text.zh-Hans: 把邀请坐下的话说清楚
text.en: Make my invitation audible

text.zh-Hans: 看看围巾有没有遮住嘴
text.en: Check that the scarf clears my mouth

lead.zh-Hans: 小石子倒出来了，鞋垫也跟着出来。
lead.en: The pebble came out, followed by the insole.

text.zh-Hans: 菠菜派和蜂蜜炸球的盘子已经收走，我在尼亚尔霍斯公园走了一会儿，鞋里忽然硌得慌。我坐下脱鞋，轻轻一倒，小石子出来了，鞋垫却也滑出半截。路过的孩子停下看，我想把它塞回去，先把脚趾顶成了一小包。重新脱鞋铺平以后，脚终于稳稳踩到了鞋底。
text.en: After the spanakopita and loukoumades plates were cleared, I walked in Stavros Niarchos Park until something pressed inside my shoe. Sitting down, I shook out a pebble and half the insole as well. A passing child stopped to watch. I tried pushing my foot back in too soon and bunched the lining under my toes. One more removal let me flatten it properly and put my foot on a smooth sole.

text.zh-Hans: 说说鞋垫为什么也跟了出来
text.en: Explain the insole’s unexpected appearance

text.zh-Hans: 把鞋垫铺平再穿鞋
text.en: Flatten the insole before putting the shoe on

lead.en: You wrote, “{reply}.” I made my greeting quieter.

text.zh-Hans: 我照你的话，在国家花园鸭池旁站远一点，等那只忙着理羽毛的鸭子停下来。它终于把头抬起，我便轻轻说你好。鸭子朝水面走去，一摇一摆，旁边的孩子也跟着摇了一下。我忍不住照做，邮包却拍到了腿上。孩子站稳后指指我，两条包带已经晃成了不同的方向。
text.en: Following your suggestion, I stood farther back at the National Garden's duck pond and waited for the preening duck to stop. When it raised its head, I said a quiet hello. It waddled towards the water. The child beside me swayed once, and I copied the movement, making my mailbag bump my leg. The child stopped and pointed. My two straps were still swinging in opposite directions.

text.zh-Hans: 和孩子轻声说再见
text.en: Say a quiet goodbye to the child

text.zh-Hans: 等两条包带停下来
text.en: Wait for both straps to stop moving

lead.zh-Hans: 打招呼的衣袖，比手先伸出来了。
lead.en: An empty sleeve reached out before my hand did.

text.zh-Hans: 橄榄树和柏树还在熟悉的位置，我回到雅典，又到尼亚尔霍斯公园散步。刚把外套披上，一位迎面走来的旅人向我点头。我急着挥手，手臂还没穿进袖子，只有空空的那一截袖口甩了出去。他笑着也抖抖自己的衣袖，我才找到袖管，把手送出来。这回抬起的手掌，终于露在袖口外面。
text.en: Olive trees and cypresses looked familiar when I returned to Stavros Niarchos Park in Athens. I was putting on my coat as a walker nodded hello. I tried to wave before my arm had found the sleeve, so only the empty cuff flapped towards them. They smiled and shook a sleeve in reply. I worked my hand through the right opening. The next greeting came from a palm finally visible beyond the cuff.

text.zh-Hans: 向旅人补一个完整的招呼
text.en: Give the walker a proper wave

text.zh-Hans: 看看手有没有穿对袖口
text.en: Check that my hand has found its sleeve
